citations.narrative:
The facility is not maintaining adequate records of acquisitions. Cage cards are used in lieu of the 7005 forms for keeping
acquisition records for litters of puppies. The facility has created a cage card for all the litters that have been born at the
facility, but they do not contain all the required information. A litter of cava-poo puppies born on 13-July-2026 and a litter
of cava-poo puppies born on 16-July-2026 have cage cards that are missing the individual identification, sex, and the
color or distinctive markings of the puppies. A third litter of cava-poo puppies born on 25-July-2026 has a cage card that is
missing the individual identification and the sex of the puppies.
Accurate record keeping is essential so that APHIS inspectors can adequately identify the movement of dogs into and out
of the facility. Each dealer shall make, keep, and maintain records for forms which fully and correctly disclose the
information concerning each dog purchased or otherwise acquired, owned, held, or which is transported, sold, or
otherwise disposed of by that dealer. The records shall include any offspring born to any animal while in his or her control.
Correct by maintaining complete records for acquisition by 27-August-2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
